description.blurb: 1620 Geographos is a highly elongated asteroid with a mean-diameter of approximately 2.5 km (1.6 mi).
description.more: In 1994, NASA's Goldstone radar telescope in the California desert revealed that asteroid Geographos had the largest length-to-width ratio of any solar system object imaged to date. As a potentially hazardous asteroid, Geographos has a minimum orbital intersection distance with Earth of less than 0.05 AU and a diameter of greater than 150 meters. It is currently 0.0301 AU (4,500,000 km), which translates into 11.7 lunar distances.
